_meta.description: India CPI annual averages converted to a continuous calendar-year series on Base 2012=100. Used to inflation-adjust all INR amounts to 2024 INR. Apply as: amount_2024 = amount_original × (CPI_2024 / CPI_year).

methodology.2012_to_2024: RBI Handbook of Statistics Table 34 (fiscal year CPI Combined, Base 2012=100). Converted to calendar year via: CY_n = (0.25 × FY_ending_Mar_n) + (0.75 × FY_ending_Mar_(n+1)). Verified: CY2012 ≈ 100.2.
methodology.2006_to_2011: RBI Table 38 CPI-IW (Base 2001=100), spliced to New CPI at FY2011-12. Link factor = 93.3 (New CPI FY2011-12) / 195.0 (estimated CPI-IW FY2011-12) = 0.4785. Calendar years computed with same (0.25/0.75) FY conversion.
methodology.1991_to_2005: RBI Table 38 CPI-IW (Base 1982=100). Converted to 2001-base via RBI's stated factor of 4.63. Then linked to New CPI as above. Calendar years 1996–2005 interpolated at derived CAGR of 5.9% p.a. to match endpoints; 1998 uses actual known inflation spike.
methodology.caveat: Pre-2012 values carry a splice uncertainty of ±5–8%. CPI-IW (industrial workers) basket differs from the New CPI Combined (rural+urban) basket. Values are best available estimates — verify against RBI/CSO official spliced series before publishing.
